in_sanskrit.name: Vajay
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Conqueror, Victorious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vajay एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vajra’ meaning ‘thunderbolt’, ‘Vajay’ is a powerful and strong name for a baby boy. It symbolizes the power of the thunderbolt, which can conquer all obstacles and bring victory.
